observations: The upper I-mark region lies inside the narrow loop below its upper sloping boundary; the lower I-mark region lies above its lower sloping boundary. The enlarged binary strokes make the two crowded regions easier to locate.

In both regions the vertical ink, letter strokes, loop edges and horizontal field crossings still merge. I cannot trace two independently distinguishable current arrowhead/shaft pairs onto specific opposing source wires with a certified direction.
The clearly rightward n and the outward diagonal F landmarks are consistent with the retained first observations. They do not determine the unreadable current associations.

The unchanged candidate's right-side upward and left-side downward currents remain the previously verified disclosed modernization. Their exact source-arrow correspondence is still not certified by these pixels.

observations: The short diagonal arrow inside the loop, beside the lower interior n label, has a distinguishable lower-left directed termination. Its shaft runs from the central interior toward that lower-left termination. It is separate from the long external F arrows. This makes the source n arrow's down-left projected direction readable in this detail.

The unchanged candidate n also points down-left. The existing SVG places its directed shaft from (320,270) toward (257.9,353.7), with an end arrowhead. These are candidate screen coordinates only, not source-given geometry. The candidate preserves the now-readable source n direction under the disclosed projection.

The lower-left I region abuts the left vertical wire and horizontal field crossings; the upper-right I region abuts the right wire and the upper-right force/field cluster. The letter/vertical ink and dark wire thickenings do not provide a sufficiently isolated pair of current arrowhead/shaft/wire associations.

I do not certify both source current directions or their selected-normal sign from these current marks. The candidate's right-up/left-down currents and prior correct maximum-torque mathematics cannot supply that missing source reading.
